public_source.claim: Best nonnegative step function then known, at n=208; coefficients published in the appendix.

T079-C01.comparison_tolerance: The printed public value is rounded to 16 decimal places; compare its decimal rounding with the exact rational checker value.
limitations: This is the best located published witness for exactly 208 nonnegative coefficients, not a proof of optimality or an exhaustive survey.

AlphaEvolve reports 1.5053 and later 1.5032 for the continuous AC1 problem using a 600-part step function; those values are not a 208-coefficient witness for this configuration: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02864.
SimpleTES reports 1.503871 for continuous AC1; its representation and reported task score are not established as this fixed 208-step objective: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19341.
Later continuous-problem reports, including 1.5029, are outside the verified 208-step configuration. No corresponding 208-coefficient witness was located.
DREAM-RSI coverage records do not list AC1 as a DREAM-RSI task; its coverage comes from SimpleTES and AlphaEvolve.
